name: realms-rpg-next
//overrides: Transitive pins added by `chore: apply npm audit fixes` (133aa520). postcss 8.5.25 hoists one copy across @tailwindcss/postcss, next and vitest's vite; sharp 0.35.3 pins next's optional image-optimization dep. `npm audit` is clean WITH these pins in place, so neither advisory can be re-confirmed from here: to retire them, delete this block, run `npm install`, then `npm audit` — if it stays at 0 vulnerabilities the pins were leftovers and should stay deleted.

scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run verify:contrast && npm run build && npm run verify:visual && npm run verify:a11y
scripts.verify:visual:update: npm run build && playwright test tests/visual/screenshots.pw.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.verify:a11y:update: npm run build && cross-env UPDATE_A11Y_BASELINE=1 playwright test tests/visual/a11y.pw.ts --workers=1 --update-snapshots
scripts.verify:auth-visual: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.auth.config.ts tests/visual/auth-screenshots.pw.ts
scripts.verify:auth-visual:update: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.auth.config.ts tests/visual/auth-screenshots.pw.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.verify:auth-a11y: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.auth.config.ts tests/visual/auth-a11y.pw.ts
scripts.verify:auth-a11y:update: npm run build && cross-env UPDATE_AUTH_A11Y_BASELINE=1 playwright test -c playwright.auth.config.ts tests/visual/auth-a11y.pw.ts --workers=1
scripts.verify:shell-creators-audit: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.shell-creators-audit.config.ts
scripts.verify:responsive: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.responsive.config.ts
scripts.verify:responsive:update: npm run build && cross-env UPDATE_RESPONSIVE_BASELINE=1 playwright test -c playwright.responsive.config.ts --workers=1
scripts.verify:chip-unification: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.chip-unification.config.ts
scripts.verify:chip-unification:update: npm run build && playwright test -c playwright.chip-unification.config.ts --update-snapshots
scripts.db:migrate: echo Run SQL in Supabase Dashboard. See sql/README.md and src/docs/SUPABASE_SCHEMA.md.
scripts.tasks:validate: npm run tasks:reconcile:strict && npm run tasks:validate-docs && npm run tasks:validate-index && npm run tasks:validate-related && npm run tasks:validate-shared-ui
scripts.backup:all: npm run db:backup && npm run storage:backup
